subject: general
question: If a + b = 50 and a - b = 21 find the value of (a + b)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the required value: **(a + b)²**.

From the given data, **a + b = 50**.

Directly square the value of the sum: **50² = 50 × 50**.

The result is **2500**. (Note: **a − b = 21** is extra information not needed for this calculation).

**∴ The correct answer is 2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers **(a + b)** = 50

Difference of two numbers **(a − b)** = 21

**Formula Used:**

The value to find is the square of the sum: **(a + b)²**

**Calculations:**

⇒ **a + b** = 50

⇒ Square both sides of the equation:

⇒ **(a + b)²** = 50²

⇒ **(a + b)²** = 50 × 50

⇒ **(a + b)²** = 2500

**∴ The correct answer is 2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Sum Identity

The expansion of the square of a binomial is given by **(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²**.

Square of a Difference Identity

The expansion for subtraction is **(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²**.

Relation between Sum and Difference

The two identities are related by the formula: **(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab**.

Redundant Information in Exams

Questions often provide more data than necessary (like **a − b = 21**) to test the student's ability to identify relevant values.</p
